::: {#def-ols}
#### Ordinary least squares

For data $(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)$,
the **residual sum of squares** of a candidate line
with intercept $b_0$ and slope $b_1$ is

$$\text{RSS}(b_0, b_1) \eqdef \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - b_0 - b_1 x_i)^2.$$

The **ordinary least squares (OLS) estimates**
$\hat\beta_0$ and $\hat\beta_1$
are the values of $b_0$ and $b_1$ that minimize $\text{RSS}(b_0, b_1)$.
:::
